subject: Make your first botanical sun print
preheader: Two hours, two prints and everything you need to begin.

content.text: Turn leaves and sunlight into your first botanical blue print. Join our beginner-friendly cyanotype workshop.
Cyanotype is a simple way to make deep-blue prints with real plants. Learn the process, make two prints, and leave with the skills to try it again.
Start with a short demo. Choose your leaves and arrange your first print.
We’ll guide you through exposing the paper and rinsing your design.
Try a second composition. Compare your prints over a cup of tea while they dry.
Paper, plants, aprons and tea are included.
Just bring yourself. No drawing skills needed.
Book one place. Make two prints.
Made by nature. Finished by you.
